name: Hydras

unlocks.name: Bigger and Badder
unlocks.notes: Allows the superior Colossal Hydra to spawn while on a Hydras task.

variantInfo.name: Hydra
notes: Hydras attack with ranged and magic, starting with a random style and switching after three attacks regardless of whether they hit.
After roughly 30 seconds a hydra spits poison at three random tiles, one at the player's location, dealing 4 poison damage every two ticks; poison immunity reduces it to 1-2.

variantInfo.name: Colossal Hydra
notes: Superior slayer monster variant that can spawn after purchasing Bigger and Badder (1/200 base spawn rate, 1/150 after elite Combat Achievements).
Has the highest imbued heart drop rate at 1/160.

variantInfo.name: Alchemical Hydra
notes: Boss variant on the lower level of Karuulm Slayer Dungeon; it can only be killed while on a hydra Slayer task, which only Konar assigns.
Four phases at 75%/50%/25% HP; each phase takes 75% reduced damage unless lured over the matching coloured vent.

locationComparison.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: 17 Hydras in the task-only area of the dungeon.
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots are required against the dungeon floor heat unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.

taskNotes: Hydras are assigned exclusively by Konar quo Maten and require 95 Slayer.
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots are mandatory in Karuulm Slayer Dungeon unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.
Hydras are draconic, so dragonbane weapons such as the dragon hunter crossbow and dragon hunter lance are effective.
Hydras alternate ranged and magic attacks, switching after three attacks; pray against the style you have the lowest defence towards and switch when the hydra switches.
After roughly 30 seconds hydras spit poison at three random tiles dealing 4 poison damage every two ticks; poison immunity reduces this to 1-2 damage.
The Alchemical Hydra boss can only be killed while on a hydra Slayer task and is the lucrative alternative for the task.
No task-extension unlock exists for Hydras; Konar assigns 125-190 at weight 10.
Blocking high-weight Konar tasks such as metal dragons, wyrms, drakes, abyssal demons, cave krakens, and black demons increases hydra assignment odds.
Brimstone keys drop from task-only kills in Konar-assigned areas.

slayerTargetId 245 is a synthetic placeholder per the WC-1..11 contract (240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value for Hydras is unverified and detection falls back to the RuneLite task-name path.
recommendedMethod: Kill the 17 hydras in the task-only Karuulm area with ranged (their ranged defence is 0) using dragonbane weapons where owned, prayer-switching against their alternating ranged/magic attacks and stepping off poison tiles; or kill the Alchemical Hydra boss for profit while on task.
